EmailTemplate.name: MOD approval - stop through EOM
EmailTemplate.subject: {!Case.Merchant_Number__c} - {!Account.Legal_Name__c}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Case.Contact},
We have good news re: your temporary loan modification request due to the Covid-19 pandemic.
We have received approval to stop the payments through the end of the month. Payments are due to resume 6/1.
We wish you and your family the best during this difficult time. Visit our site for updates and support for our customers: {!Case.Email_Website_Address__c}
We also encourage you to reach out to your banking partner for immediate assistance with loans administered by the SBA.
Sincerely,
Loan Modification Team
{!Case.Email_Signature_Company__c} 9820 Towne Centre Drive San Diego, CA 92121
